title: Run KMC TPD simulation for Co/Pt cluster
action: Implement a lattice KMC solver for N2 desorption on a hexagonal Co cluster on Pt(111) using the energetics from the provided kmc_inputs.json. Run TPD with heating rate 3 K/s, initial N coverage 0.3, averaging over 20 random seeds. Record full trajectories including timestamps, temperatures, site occupations, and association events.
description: Raw KMC event data for Co/Pt simulation.

title: Run KMC TPD simulation for Ni/Pt cluster
action: Implement a lattice KMC solver for N2 desorption on a hexagonal Ni cluster on Pt(111) using the energetics from the provided kmc_inputs.json. Run TPD with heating rate 3 K/s, initial N coverage 0.3, averaging over 20 random seeds. Record full trajectories.
description: Raw KMC event data for Ni/Pt simulation.

title: Compute Co/Pt desorption curve
action: From the Co/Pt trajectory (kmc_co_trajectory.npz), compute the temperature-binned desorption rate averaged over seeds. Write tpd_co.csv with columns temperature (K) and desorption_rate (s^{-1}).
description: TPD spectrum for Co/Pt. The peak temperature derived from this file is the primary scored quantity.
output_schema: Columns: temperature (float, K), desorption_rate (float, s^{-1}). At least 100 rows covering 400-1000 K.

title: Compute Co/Pt site-resolved kinetics
action: Using the Co/Pt trajectory, compute time-averaged site-specific occupation probabilities and association rates in the temperature window 600-720 K. Write site_analysis_co.json as a mapping from site type (e.g., fcc, hcp, step_110, step_100, edge) to an object with average_occupation (float) and average_association_rate (float).
description: Site-resolved kinetic statistics for Co/Pt around the peak temperature.
output_schema: {"site_type": {"average_occupation": float (0-1), "average_association_rate": float (>=0)}} for each of fcc, hcp, step_110, step_100, edge.

title: Compute Ni/Pt desorption curve
action: From the Ni/Pt trajectory (kmc_ni_trajectory.npz), compute the temperature-binned desorption rate averaged over seeds. Write tpd_ni.csv with columns temperature (K) and desorption_rate (s^{-1}).
output_schema: Columns: temperature (float, K), desorption_rate (float, s^{-1}). At least 100 rows covering 400-800 K.

title: Compute Ni/Pt site-resolved kinetics
action: Using the Ni/Pt trajectory, compute time-averaged site-specific occupation probabilities and association rates in the temperature window 500-640 K. Write site_analysis_ni.json with the same structure as the Co/Pt file.
description: Site-resolved kinetic statistics for Ni/Pt around the peak temperature.

title: Compute peak temperatures
action: Read tpd_co.csv and tpd_ni.csv. Locate the temperature at which desorption_rate is maximum in each. Write peak_temperatures.json with keys co_peak_T and ni_peak_T (values in Kelvin).
description: Reported peak temperatures for consistency check; the checker will recompute peaks from the CSV files independently.
